# `aitbc market jobs`

List market jobs.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc market jobs [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--service-type` | text | — | no | Filter by service type (e.g. ipfs) |
| `--state` | text | — | no | Filter by job state |
| `--buyer-address` | text | — | no | Filter by buyer address |
| `--offer-id` | text | — | no | Filter by offer ID |
| `--limit` | integer | `100` | no | Maximum jobs to return |
| `--output` | choice | — | no | Output format (alias for --format) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc market jobs
aitbc market jobs --output json
```
